BI2.source:
function BI2 takes nothing returns boolean
local integer WY
if WS==0 or Q5==null then
call BJDebugMsg("Fusion: 필수 설정이 제공되지 않았습니다.")
return false
endif
set WY=GetPlayerId(Q5)
if not BGc(WS,WY) then
return false
endif
call BGd(WS,WY)
call BGe(WS,WY)
call TriggerEvaluate(Q4)
return true
endfunction

CH8.source:
function CH8 takes nothing returns nothing
local unit iI=GetEnteringUnit()
local integer JG=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(iI))
local timer Db
if GetUnitAbilityLevel(iI,$416C6F63)>0 then
set iI=null
return
endif

set iI=null
return
endif

call BH1(LZ[JG],iI)
call BkC(iI)
endif

set LL[JG]=LL[JG]+10
set Db=BHs(JG)
call TimerStart(Db,.01,false,function CH6)
set Db=null
set iI=null
return
endif
if GetUnitTypeId(iI)==$68303431 then
set LL[JG]=LL[JG]+10
set Db=BHs(JG)
call TimerStart(Db,.01,false,function CH7)
set Db=null
set iI=null
return
endif
if GetUnitTypeId(iI)==$68303748 then
call Bc6(iI,GetRectCenterX(Lm[JG]),GetRectCenterY(Lm[JG]))
call UnitRemoveAbilityBJ($416D6F76,iI)
set iI=null
return
endif
if GetUnitTypeId(iI)==$68303335 then
call Btf(JG,iI)
set iI=null

endif

call BuF(JG,iI)

return

CHu.source:
function CHu takes nothing returns nothing
local player hk=Player(Wl)
local integer ho=Wn
local integer hs=Wo
local integer ht
if GetUnitTypeId(GetSpellTargetUnit())==ho then
set hs=hs+1
endif
set ht=hs-BH3(LZ[GetPlayerId(hk)],ho,function CHt)
if ht>0 then
call DisplayTextToPlayer(hk,0,0,"재료 부족 : "+GetObjectName(ho)+" "+I2S(ht)+"개")
call BGb(false)
endif
set hk=null
endfunction

CHx.source:
function CHx takes nothing returns nothing
local player hu=Player(Wl)
local integer h6=Wn
local integer hv=Wo
local integer VU=LZ[GetPlayerId(hu)]
if WT!=null and h6==WU then
if IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(),UNIT_TYPE_HERO) then
call RemoveUnit(WT)
else
call BdD(WT)
endif
set hv=hv-1
endif
set hv=hv-BH4(VU,h6,hv,function CHv)
call BH4(VU,h6,hv,function CHw)
set hu=null
endfunction

CHy.source:
function CHy takes nothing returns nothing
local player iF=Player(Wl)
local integer iH=Wn
local integer iG=Wo
local integer VU=LZ[GetPlayerId(iF)]
local real EN
local real JS
local unit Cm
local integer EK=0
if WV then
set EN=WW
set JS=WX
else
set EN=GetPlayerStartLocationX(iF)
set JS=GetPlayerStartLocationY(iF)
endif
loop
exitwhen EK==iG
set Cm=CreateUnit(iF,iH,EN,JS,bj_UNIT_FACING)
if GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303939 or GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48304232 then
call BH0(VU,Cm,$48303854)
else
call BH1(VU,Cm)
endif
call GroupAddUnit(Q6,Cm)
set EK=EK+1
endloop
set iF=null
set Cm=null
endfunction
